observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Street side in New York City on a sidewalk next to a building, as part of a cultural gathering or parade
observation.formation_and_space: Semi-circle around musicians, with individual dancers taking turns in the center and moving in a line formation holding hands
observation.posture: Upright torso, slightly bent knees, natural body weight
observation.footwork: Bouncy stepping pattern keeping time with the drums, alternating feet, cannot see exact heel-toe rolls due to long skirts and camera distance
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held wide or holding the sides of long skirts to sway them, hands raised or holding hands in a line
observation.hips_and_torso: Active hip movements and side-to-side torso shifts
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Full rotations and spins, occasional level changes to lower the body while maintaining skirt movement
observation.costume_and_props: Full-length skirts in bright blue and white, matching headbands/wraps, sleeveless or halter tops
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and precise weight shifts are obscured by long skirt hems and low-resolution video recording

signature_moments.what: Dancers spinning rapidly while holding and swirling wide skirts
